code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    # The paired markers on a common row define the horizontal spine.
    counts={r:sum(1 for rr,cc in pts if rr==r) for r,c in pts}
    spine=max((r for r,n in counts.items() if n>=2), key=lambda r: counts[r])
    cols=[c for r,c in pts if r==spine]
    lo,hi=min(cols),max(cols)
    for c in range(lo+1,hi):
        if out[spine][c]==0: out[spine][c]=3
    for r,c in pts:
        if r!=spine:
            for rr in range(min(r,spine)+1,max(r,spine)):
                if out[rr][c]==0: out[rr][c]=3
    return out
'''
